name: matmul

findings.text: compute-bound: matrix core 72% busy, 89 TFLOP/s = 72% of the bf16 peak
the matrix core idles 17% of the kernel with its waves at vmem_wait (s_waitcnt on vmcnt: global loads (or gfx950's DMA into LDS) not back)
tail: 1024 workgroups = 7.11 rounds of 48 WGPs x 3; the last fills 16/144, leaving 11% of the slot-time idle
the matrix core idles 9% of the kernel with its waves at no_instruction (between instructions: none ready to issue (instruction fetch, a dependency the hardware tracks without an s_waitcnt))

verdict.line: compute-bound: matrix core 72% busy, 89 TFLOP/s = 72% of the bf16 peak; matrix core idle at vmem_wait 17%; tail: 7.11 rounds of 48 WGPs, the last fills 16/144 (11% idle); matrix core idle at no_instruction 9%

cannot: matrix-core (WMMA) activity: no counter counts WMMA instructions or busy cycles; hk.profile counts them from the thread trace (executions x FLOPs each) or reports the achieved FLOP/s against the peak instead
MFMA-style per-type instruction counts: only VALU, SALU, LDS, SMEM, texture load/store and FLAT are counted
Infinity Cache (MALL) hits: GL2C_EA/MC requests are past the L2, whether the MALL or GDDR6 served them
per-type active cycles (SQ_ACTIVE_INST_*), VMEM latency and CU busy: not exposed on gfx11; the thread trace attributes the waits

ceilings.source: W7900D: the bf16 WMMA peak and GDDR6 at 18 Gbps x 384 bits (hk.integration.headroom.PEAKS); the fastest cache-resident rate measured, 2.43 TB/s at <= 96 MB (hk.check.CARDS). A measured WMMA loop reaches 100.5 TFLOP/s (hk.target.gfx1100.CEILINGS)

notes: the first counter pass read GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE = 0 for kernels that ran: the remaining counter passes were skipped
the hardware counters read zero here (GRBM_GUI_ACTIVE = 0 for kernels that ran): counter collection does not work on this machine, so they are ignored; timing, the thread trace and the ISA remain

compare.line: hipblaslt takes 1.288x the time of matmul (interleaved in one process: 2086.6 vs 1612.5 us, band 3%); profiled calls: hipblaslt 1987.8 us vs matmul 1546.6 us (1.285x the time); matrix core idle after the main loop (drain + epilogue) 1.1% -> 1.4% of the kernel; matrix core busy 72% -> 57%; waves a SIMD 6 -> 4; workgroups 1,024 -> 1,849; loop instructions per matrix one 3.062 -> 4.056
